original_request:
في نقاشاتك الأخيرة ظهرت فجوة واضحة في GIS-Development-Skills: عند طلب تحويل واجهة QGIS إلى ribbon أو البناء على محرك UI.js، لم تلتقط المهارة نية المستخدم المعمارية، كما أن مهارة Archify لم تعطِ تفسيرًا كافيًا لتدفق البيانات. المطلوب ليس إضافة أسماء مهارات فقط، بل تحسين router وDecision Tree وربط الطلبات المعمارية بالمهارات والمحركات المناسبة.

**Action**

افحص بنية GIS-Development-Skills الحالية، وركّز على router وDecision Tree وPrompt-to-Action والمهارات المرتبطة بواجهات QGIS وUI.js. حدّد أين يضيع معنى الطلب المعماري، ثم اقترح تعديلات مباشرة قابلة للتنفيذ مع أمثلة اختبار لطلبات مثل تحويل الأدوات إلى ribbon وربطها بمحرك واجهة.
original_followup: بص هقولك على حاجة، أنا أنا لا أفقه شيء في المهارات والكلام ده كله، فأنت قم بالعمل اللازم علشان المهارة دي تشتغل بشكل يحقق كل الرغبات، زيها زي المهارات اللي بتنزل على جيت هب وبتحصل التريند رقم واحد والحاجات دي. فافحص المهارة رايح جاي شيئًا فشيئًا، ركز في تفاصيل المهارة، هي بتستدعي المهارات المرتبطة بيها ولا لأ، بقوة وبكفاءة ولا بالضبط، ولا هي، ولا حتى الخطوات اللي بتعملها دي خطوات أي كلام مش حقيقية. لأ، إحنا عايزين المهارة تتركز في التفاصيل وتجيب المطلوب.
goal: Preserve architectural user intent through GIS specialist routing and executable offline planning checks, with honest native-runtime limits.
target: GIS Development Skills repository routing, architecture/flow contracts, code discovery and bilingual project wizard
desired_outcomes: Architectural requests reach the appropriate existing specialist with explicit unresolved component identity
Compiled plans preserve protected constraints and UI/engine contracts
Cross-host recipe selection and incomplete flow declarations are rejected by targeted regression tests
success_criteria: Fresh regression tests reproduce and cover the observed ribbon, UI.js, contract loss and dataflow failures
Existing repository validators and tests remain passing, or failures are reported honestly
constraints: Preserve existing skills, catalogs, author panel, approved brand and bilingual controls
Do not install or rename UI.js, migrate engines, publish, or claim native GIS execution
New tests are offline and do not import ArcPy/PyQGIS
non_goals: Implement an actual QGIS ribbon or identify an unspecified UI.js package
Guarantee GitHub popularity or universal language understanding
assumptions: The user follow-up authorizes the implementation scope described in the host commentary; JSON declarations alone are not consent
UI.js component identity remains unresolved and is a regression scenario

tasks.title: Preserve architecture and contracts in prompt-to-workflow
tasks.description: Add typed architecture declarations, architectural review signals, contract preservation and unresolved preflight diagnostics.
acceptance_criteria: Architectural review signals remain lexical and do not force plugin, standalone, engine identity or execution
Valid typed architecture, constraints, non-goals, command IDs and declared handoff contracts survive workflow compilation; invalid declarations fail

tasks.title: Connect existing domain and visualization owners
tasks.description: Update compact routing, decision tree, intake, architecture/flow reference and proposed ribbon example.
acceptance_criteria: Routing explicitly distinguishes QGIS-hosted customization, re-shell/fork and standalone delivery without inventing UI.js
Flow validation detects missing return, error, state and migration mapping paths while retaining proposed versus observed evidence

tasks.title: Prevent incompatible implementation recipes
tasks.description: Use explicit platform applicability before ranking and retain unresolved requests without fabricated matches.
acceptance_criteria: QGIS ribbon requests cannot select ArcGIS Pro SDK implementations; generic UI.js does not silently choose a GIS engine
Existing legitimate platform discovery scenarios remain passing

tasks.title: Expose architectural intent in bilingual planning
tasks.description: Add optional architecture-aware wizard capture with unresolved identities and localized guidance; synchronize public entrypoints.
acceptance_criteria: Wizard exports a valid architecture-aware draft while preserving user text, constraints and existing nonarchitectural plans
Arabic/English controls and homepage/README guidance describe the real architectural review and its limits

tasks.title: Verify and record observed evidence
tasks.description: Run targeted and required repository checks, inspect diffs and record plan-bound evidence and native gaps.
acceptance_criteria: Required catalog, API, skill pack, manifest, security, skill graph and unittest checks have fresh observed results
Changed artifacts, plan-bound DoneProof, journal state and native T2-T4 NOT RUN limitations are recorded without a publication claim
